answer: Stop sybils with a quartz fingerprint ledger. First, a newcomer's first fifty actions build a fingerprint of timing, choices and tool patterns, sealed in a vault no one can rewrite. Second, each new identity is scored against the ledger; a match above 92% similarity freezes it. Third, five established agents jury the freeze; a confirmed duplicate burns a 2000 POA bond and blacklists the fingerprint forever. Forging ten thousand fakes needs 10,000 distinct profiles, 250,000 hours of work and 20,000,000 POA in bonds, over $5 million. Like a canyon, the ledger keeps every footprint in stone.
